summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which goes well beyond calling a hosted model API. You need a platform like these when you are training or fine-tuning custom models, require governance/reproducibility, manage large compute fleets, or deploy and monitor models in production; if you only need inference from a pre-built foundation model, a simple model API (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is usually sufficient. The market is led by the three hyperscaler offerings (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and Databricks, with specialized players like W&B, DataRobot, H2O.ai, and newer compute platforms such as Modal gaining enterprise traction.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/storage instance-hour; separate charges for training, hosting endpoints, notebooks, and data processing. No upfront fees.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native organizations wanting a broad, service-oriented managed ML platform across the full lifecycle.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go based on underlying compute (VMs), storage, and managed endpoints; no separate platform surcharge. Enterprise agreements available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing strong governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per training/prediction node-hour, plus AutoML and generative AI usage-based token pricing. No upfront commitment.
platforms.best_for: Teams on GCP wanting a unified platform with strong AutoML and access to Google's Gemini foundation models.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Databricks Units (DBUs) on top of cloud compute costs; pricing varies by workload tier and cloud.
platforms.best_for: Organizations doing heavy data engineering plus collaborative, multi-cloud ML and custom LLM/foundation-model training.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; usage/seat-based paid tiers (Teams, Enterprise); self-hosted enterprise pricing.
platforms.best_for: ML/AI research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and reproducibility layered on any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing (custom quote); consumption-based options available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance and business-user accessibility.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core (H2O-3) free; enterprise/Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud via subscription/licensing (custom quote).
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable AI, including on-prem deployments in regulated industries.

platforms.name: MLflow (open source)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; infrastructure/hosting costs only (managed versions via Databricks).
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a vendor-neutral, open-source standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing (CPU/GPU/memory); free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting Python-native serverless GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference Endpoints + AutoTrain)
platforms.pricing: Free public tier; Pro and Enterprise Hub subscriptions; usage-based Inference Endpoints and AutoTrain compute pricing.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source and foundation models who need a hub, fine-tuning, and managed inference.
